Traditional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer ease of use and a established customer base, but they come with significant restrictions and fees. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a customizable and scalable solution that can be deployed in any country, without relying on third-party platforms. This approach gives creators full ownership and control over their stores, as well as the ability to automate payments and delivery.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides full ownership and control over your online store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of ownership and control it provides. Creators have full access to their store's code and data, and can automate payments and delivery using tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. This approach also enables instant product delivery, reducing the need for manual intervention and minimizing the risk of errors or delays.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators who need a reliable and scalable solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice. With its customizable and automated approach, it provides a level of flexibility and control that traditional platforms simply can't match. Whether you're selling stock photos, ebooks, or software, sovereign commerce infrastructure can provide a secure and efficient way to receive payments and deliver products to your customers.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a suitable hosting platform, such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, choose a backend logic tool, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and configure it to automate payments and delivery. Then, select a storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, to store orders and customer data. Finally, integrate a payment processing service, like NOWPayments, to enable fast and secure transactions. With these components in place, you can launch your online store and start selling digital products to customers around the world.
